concepts.def: Common pop structure alternating verses and a memorable repeated chorus.
Chord progression I-IV-V over 12 bars; underpins blues, rock and roll.
Short, repeated melodic or rhythmic idea, common in rock and jazz.
Catchy musical phrase that grabs the listener; often part of the chorus.
Reusing a portion of a sound recording in a new track, central to hip-hop.
Digital Audio Workstation (e.g., Logic, Ableton) used for recording and producing music.
